query: INSERT INTO echeance_ligne (cabinet_id, dossier_id, ecriture_id, position, date_echeance) SELECT b.cabinet_id, b.dossier_id, b.brouillon_id, b.position, b.date_echeance FROM brouillon_ligne b JOIN ecriture_validee_ligne v ON v.cabinet_id = b.cabinet_id AND v.dossier_id = b.dossier_id AND v.ecriture_id = b.brouillon_id AND v.position = b.position AND v.compte_numero = b.compte_numero AND v.sens = b.sens AND v.montant = b.montant AND v.tiers_id = b.tiers_id WHERE b.cabinet_id = $1 AND b.dossier_id = $2 AND b.brouillon_id = $3 AND b.date_echeance IS NOT NULL
